summary: Iteration 61 - Comprehensive stability check passed. All P0 features verified: Theme Color Customization (6 accent colors: purple, pink, blue, green, orange, red), Dark/Light Mode Toggle, Personal Reports 3-image upload (0/3, max 6.9MB each), Easter Egg Statistics section on Statistics page, PayPal Wallet UI accessible from Settings. Backend: 21/22 tests passed (1 minor endpoint issue). Frontend: All features working, no console errors.

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed - endpoint may not exist or wrong HTTP method

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext.js - Well implemented with 6 accent colors (purple, pink, blue, green, orange, red), localStorage persistence, CSS variables for theming
Sidebar.js - Theme controls (Dark Mode + Accent Color picker) properly integrated at bottom of sidebar nav
PersonalReportsPage.js - 3-image upload support with proper validation (max 6.9MB each), preview grid, remove functionality
StatisticsPage.js - Easter Egg Statistics section displays user stats (Eggs Caught, Total XP, Hunter Rank), global stats (Total Discoveries, Available Eggs), leaderboards
PayPalWalletPage.js - Complete wallet UI with balance cards (Pending, Total Earned, Total Paid Out), PayPal email input, payout request, admin section
updated_files: /app/tests/test_iteration61_features.py - Created comprehensive test suite for iteration 61 features
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 61 verified all P0 features: 1) Theme Color Customization - 6 accent colors (Royal Purple, Hot Pink, Ocean Blue, Forest Green, Sunset Orange, Ruby Red) selectable from sidebar color picker. 2) Dark/Light Mode Toggle - switches between ☀️Light Mode and 🌙Dark Mode, persists to localStorage. 3) Personal Reports 3-image support - form shows 'Images (0/3, max 6.9MB each)' with file upload, preview grid, and remove buttons. 4) Easter Egg Statistics on Statistics page - shows user stats (Eggs Caught, Total XP, Hunter Rank), global stats (Total Discoveries, Available Eggs), Most Discovered/Rarest Eggs, Top Egg Hunters leaderboard. 5) PayPal Wallet accessible from Settings - shows balance cards, PayPal email input, payout request button, admin section with all wallets table. 6) Marketplace page loads correctly with all tabs. 7) Chat page loads with Real-Time Chat header.

Theme_Color_Customization.details: 6 accent colors available: Royal Purple, Hot Pink, Ocean Blue, Forest Green, Sunset Orange, Ruby Red. Color picker accessible from sidebar with data-testid='accent-color-toggle'. Each color has data-testid='accent-color-{color}'.

Dark_Light_Mode_Toggle.details: Toggle found in sidebar with data-testid='dark-mode-toggle'. Switches between '☀️Light Mode' (in dark theme) and '🌙Dark Mode' (in light theme). Theme persists via localStorage.

Personal_Reports_3_Images.details: Form shows 'Images (0/3, max 6.9MB each)' label. File input with data-testid='report-image-input' found. Backend endpoint POST /api/personal-reports/{id}/image exists.

Easter_Egg_Statistics.details: Section with data-testid='easter-egg-statistics-section' found on Statistics page. Shows: Your Egg Hunting Stats (Eggs Caught, Total XP, Hunter Rank), Global Easter Egg Statistics (Total Discoveries, Available Eggs), Most Discovered Eggs, Rarest Eggs, Top Egg Hunters leaderboard.

PayPal_Wallet_Page.details: Page with data-testid='paypal-wallet-page' accessible from Settings. Shows: Pending Balance ($0.00, Min payout: $1.00), Total Earned (All Time), Total Paid Out, PayPal Email input with Save button, Keep Earning message, Admin section with Process All Eligible Payouts button.

Marketplace_Page.details: Page loads with data-testid='marketplace-page'. All tabs present: Browse FREE, Bundles, Sell & Earn, My Purchases, My Earnings.

Chat_Functionality.details: Chat page loads with '💬 Real-Time Chat' header showing online count. Chat elements (DM, Chat Room, Messages, Online) found in page.

Backend_APIs.details: 21/22 backend tests passed. Health, auth, personal reports, Easter Egg stats, PayPal wallet, marketplace, statistics, chat APIs all working.
